items.headline: Claude Code's "25% Increase" Is Actually a Cut, Coming September 14
items.summary: Anthropic said it's permanently raising Claude Code's weekly usage limits by 25% for Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise plans starting September 14. The catch: Claude Code has had a temporary 50% boost in place for months, so on that date your real limit drops about 17% from what you have right now, even though it's technically a "25% increase" over the original baseline.
items.why_it_matters: If you use Claude Code (Anthropic's coding assistant tool) regularly, you'll hit your weekly cap sooner starting September 14. Worth checking your current usage now so a sudden cutoff mid-project doesn't catch you off guard.

opportunity.action_note: If you rely on Claude Code week to week, check your current usage under Settings before September 14 and plan heavier tasks around the coming drop in your weekly cap.

items.headline: Claude Can Now Browse the Web Right Inside the Desktop App, No Extension Needed
items.summary: Anthropic added a built-in web browser to Claude's Cowork feature in the desktop app (Mac, Windows, and Linux in beta). When a task needs a website, Claude opens it in a side panel, reads the page, and can click and type to fill out forms or pull data, all without you installing the separate Claude in Chrome extension. It's a separate browser from your own, so Claude doesn't see your regular tabs or passwords unless you choose to bring specific site logins over.
items.why_it_matters: If you've wanted Claude to handle web-based busywork, like checking a vendor portal or filling out a form, this makes it easier to get started since there's nothing extra to install. It's rolling out over the next week to Pro, Max, and Team plans.

opportunity.angle: I gave Claude's new built-in browser a real business task and watched what it could (and couldn't) do

items.headline: Anthropic Launches a Free Claude Offering for K-12 Schools
items.summary: Anthropic introduced Claude for Teachers, a free tier for schools and districts that gives teachers centrally managed access to Claude with lesson-planning skills built around learning science and alignment to academic standards in all 50 states. Student data isn't used to train Anthropic's models.
items.why_it_matters: If you do any tutoring, coaching, or homeschool-adjacent content, or just want to point a teacher friend or your kid's school toward a safe, free AI option, this is a concrete resource to share, not just another AI headline.
